_comment: T4 interim REAL suspension list (thread 057 partial close -- see docs/handoffs/057-timeseries-data-audit.md reply). Hand-curated, WebSearch-verified as of as_of_date below. Every entry must have a real, checkable source; per project rule ('never fabricate or guess a name or game count'), a player is left OUT entirely rather than approximated if not confirmable. This session ran an exhaustive pass (multiple WebSearch queries across PED/personal-conduct/gambling suspension angles, cross-checked against publication dates with WebFetch) and found exactly ONE real, currently-pending (not yet served), 2026-season suspension: Charles Snowden (Cowboys DE, 3 games, personal-conduct policy, announced 2026-07-14, effective Week 4). He is NOT included as a suspensions-mechanism entry below because he is a defensive lineman -- this board has no individual defensive-player scoring at all (K/DEF excluded from ranking per ADR-039; DEF replacement level is permanently None, see league.json/CURRENT-STATE.md), so his suspension has zero fantasy-board consequence and a fixture row for him would never be looked up (board rows are keyed by player_id_gsis for QB/RB/WR/TE only). Several other search hits (Jameson Williams, Alvin Kamara, DK Metcalf, Rashee Rice) were investigated and confirmed to be EITHER already fully served (DK Metcalf's 2-game suspension covered the final 2 games of the 2025 season, already complete before this 2026 as_of_date) OR explicitly ruled NOT suspended for 2026 (Rashee Rice -- NFL ruling, April 2026, no suspension) OR stale search-index bleed-through from 2023/2024 (Jameson Williams' 2023 gambling suspension and 2024 PED suspension, both long since served). None of these qualify as a real, current, unserved 2026 skill-position suspension, so none are listed. This file is intentionally empty of suspension entries -- that is the honest, verified state, not an oversight. Re-run this search periodically (thread 057) since suspensions are announced continuously through the season.
